body:
Founder real-time: 'can we add auto linking to the email and the links on the exports also can we allow for markdown in the summary so that we can have hyperlinks there too?' Auto-linking: email becomes a real mailto: link; each profile entry with a real URL becomes a real, clickable link (safeHref adds a missing https:// scheme to a bare 'github.com/x/y'-style entry) -- a username-only profile stays honest plain text since there's no real URL to link to. New pdfSegment/pdfDrawSegments/pdfSegmentsWidth helpers render these as real, independently-linked/colored segments, centered (classic) or right-aligned (compact) as a whole group -- fpdf's own CellFormat align modes can't do that for a sequence of independently-linked segments the way a single plain string can. Markdown links in Basics.Summary: a real, narrow [text](url) subset via fpdf's own Write/WriteLinkString (the real, documented primitives for mixing plain and linked text within one flowing paragraph -- MultiCell has no equivalent). Deliberately scoped to Basics.Summary only, not Work-entry summaries, since Write/WriteLinkString aren't column-width-aware and would overflow the compact template's own 2-column layout. Real, named security measure (safeHref): javascript:/data:/vbscript:/file: schemes never become a real link in either the PDF or the paired console.html change, rendered as their own literal text instead. 10 new Go tests verified via the confirmed-empirically fact that fpdf stores a link's own /URI target as plain, uncompressed text in the PDF's object structure (checked directly against real RenderPDF output). Paired console.html change: new escAttr()/safeHref()/renderMarkdownLink()/renderMarkdownSummary(), verified with 21 real Node checks including XSS-shaped payloads (HTML in link text, a literal quote in a URL, a javascript: scheme) -- confirmed no attribute breakout and no dangerous scheme ever becomes a real link. Full suite green. Live-verified against real production data: the real account's own real email and GitHub profile URL both correctly became real clickable links in the actual generated PDF. Deployed live.

⚓ ☃
title: Community Tools: real auto-linking (email/profile links) + markdown links in the summary
